Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and bouillon. Mix well. Marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. CHICKEN AU POIVRE 🇫🇷🔥 I genuinely wonder if the French are so fed up with people butchering their cuisine that they’ve started rioting in Paris. Perhaps this recipe was the final straw. Anyway, I’m convinced you could add cream to literally ANYTHING and it would taste good. BUT IT TASTES EVEN BETTER WHEN YOU ADD ALL THE SPICES LISTED BELOW. 🤓 Crispy, beautifully seasoned chicken thighs smothered in a rich, creamy peppercorn sauce, served alongside perfectly seasoned potato wedges. If you’re on a diet LIKE ME, I suggest you look away because we’re not counting calories today. 🤝 INGREDIENTS For the Chicken: 8–9 chicken thighs 2 tsp paprika 1 tsp smoked paprika 2 tsp onion powder 2 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp dried thyme 1½ tsp dried rosemary 1 chicken bouillon cube, crumbled Olive oil Salt, to taste 🥛 For the Creamy Peppercorn Sauce: 400g single cream 4–5 tbsp coarsely ground black pepper 1 red onion or shallot, finely chopped 4 garlic cloves, minced 1 tbsp freshly chopped rosemary 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tsp vinegar ½ tsp yellow mustard or Dijon mustard 1 cup chicken stock or water For the Potato Wedges: 6–7 🙂 small potatoes 1 tsp paprika 2 tsp onion powder 2 tsp dried parsley 3–4 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste METHOD: 1️⃣ Marinate the Chicken  Add your chicken thighs to a bowl along with all the chicken seasonings and a drizzle of olive oil. Give everything a good mix, making sure every piece is thoroughly coated. Leave to marinate for at least 30 minutes, although the longer you leave it, the better the flavour. 🤝 2️⃣ Prepare the Peppercorn Sauce  Finely chop your onion, garlic and fresh rosemary. Make sure your black pepper is coarsely ground rather than finely powdered. We want that beautiful peppercorn flavour and texture, not a mouthful of pepper dust. 💀 Combine the cream, black pepper, onion, garlic, rosemary, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar and mustard. Give everything a good mix and set aside. 3️⃣ Prepare the Potato Wedges  Slice your potatoes into wedges, or whatever shape your heart desires. Add the paprika, onion powder, dried parsley, olive oil and salt. Mix everything thoroughly, making sure those potatoes are generously coated. Get them straight into a preheated oven or air fryer at 180°C until golden, crispy and cooked through, turning halfway. Don’t leave them sitting around after seasoning because the salt will start drawing moisture out of the potatoes. 🤓 4️⃣ Sear the Chicken  Heat a large pan over medium heat and place your marinated chicken thighs skin-side down. Let the skin slowly render its fat and develop a beautiful golden crust. Don’t rush this part! Good things take time, and crispy chicken skin is definitely one of them. Once nicely browned, flip the chicken and sear the other side for a few minutes. 5️⃣ Bring Everything Together  Pour approximately 1 cup of chicken stock or water into the pan. Now add your prepared creamy peppercorn mixture. Give everything a gentle stir, making sure all those browned bits from the bottom of the pan get incorporated into the sauce. Allow everything to simmer gently until the chicken is completely cooked through and the sauce has thickened beautifully. The chicken should reach an internal temperature of at least 75°C. Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning if necessary. 6️⃣ Serve & Enjoy  Plate up your crispy potato wedges alongside those juicy chicken thighs. Now SMOTHER everything in that rich, creamy peppercorn sauce. Finish with a sprinkle of freshly chopped chives to make the whole thing healthy. 🙂 And there you have it. Chicken au poivre with a little extra personality. BON APPÉTIT, OR WHATEVER THE FRENCH SAY.

Crispy Baked Chicken Thighs Get ready for the ultimate easy dinner. These bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs are seasoned to perfection and baked until the skin is beautifully shattered-crisp while the meat stays incredibly juicy and tender. Ingredients Chicken: 6 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs Oil: 1.5 tbsp olive oil (or melted butter) The Seasoning Blend: 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp dried oregano or thyme 1 tsp kosher salt 1/2 tsp cracked black pepper 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, for a tiny kick) Instructions Prep: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet or baking dish with aluminum foil for easy cleanup. Dry the Skin: Pat the chicken thighs completely dry with paper towels. This is the most important step for achieving maximum skin crispiness! Season: In a small bowl, mix all the spices together. Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken thighs, then rub the spice mixture generously all over them, making sure to get underneath the skin as well. Arrange: Place the chicken thighs on the prepared baking sheet, skin-side up, leaving a little space between each piece so they roast instead of steam. Bake: Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the skin is deeply browned and crispy, and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) at the thickest part. Rest: Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving to lock in all those delicious juices. Tip: If you want an extra-shattery, charred crust, pop them under the oven broiler for the last 2–3 minutes of cooking. Just keep a close eye on them so they don't burn! #BakedChicken #ChickenThighs #EasyDinner #CrispyChicken #SheetPanDinner
